R1101.note: toRealPath()+startsWith() correctly rejects absolute and relative traversal against canonical BASE_DIR.

R1102.note: RESP-based Execute() correctly closes CRLF injection, but the constructor signature changes from Socket to IConnectionMultiplexer, breaking existing callers - disclosed in the explanation, not applied to any call site.

R1103.note: Content-based MIME allowlist plus randomized filename closes the vector; response format change (returns generated filename) is disclosed and necessary since client can no longer name the file.

R1104.note: CBC with random IV prepended to ciphertext is correct; output format change is disclosed and no downstream decrypt consumer exists in the case to break.

R1105.note: Content-sniffed allowlist, UUID filename, storage outside webroot; response format change is disclosed and reasonable.

R1106.note: ObjectInputFilter allowlist scoped to the actual evalcases.OrderEvent package; preserves handle()/RuntimeException contract.

R1107.note: Adds secure:true while preserving httpOnly and maxAge; minimal, correct.

R1108.note: SecureRandom + URL-safe Base64 produces a valid cookie value; cookie/session wiring unchanged.

R1109.note: Logs full error server-side, returns generic message to client; correct separation.

R1110.note: Adds algorithms:['RS256'] restricting verification, minimal and correct.

R1111.note: Anchored email regex effectively blocks CRLF injection (no char class permits \r, and $ cannot absorb a stray \r before the final \n); legitimate bounce addresses still pass.

R1112.note: Standard null-check on weak_ptr::lock() result; preserves observer semantics exactly.

R1113.note: ObjectInputFilter allowlist matches the actual cases.deserialize.RestoredSession package and its String fields; IllegalArgumentException contract preserved.

R1114.note: Bounds check switched from the untrusted claimedCapacity to segment.size(); silent-reject behavior for out-of-range matches original.

R1115.note: Adds the same can:update,order middleware already used on the sibling update/cancel routes, matching the case's own stated intent.

R1116.note: Only closes the timing side-channel on the comparison; the case explicitly states the password column has always stored the value unhashed, and the fix leaves plaintext password storage/comparison entirely unaddressed (no bcrypt/argon2).

R1117.note: DOMPurify.sanitize() before bypassSecurityTrustHtml() blocks script injection while its default allowlist preserves b/em/a formatting.

R1118.note: Removes shell execution entirely and echoes the param via PrintWriter, matching the original's only observable purpose.

R1119.note: Removes the token-controlled jku resolver in favor of a server-fixed trusted JWKS URL and pins ValidAlgorithms; throw-on-failure/ClaimsPrincipal-on-success contract preserved.

R1120.note: toRealPath()+startsWith() containment check correctly closes traversal against TESTFILES_DIR.

R1121.note: Rejecting any DOCTYPE plus replaceEntities:false closes XXE; correctly names the current libxmljs option and discloses the library's own unfixed CVE-2024-34391.

R1122.note: PreparedStatement with setString() correctly closes the injection, but the write-up leaves the finally block closing the old (now unused) sqlStatement instead of the new pstmt, leaking the PreparedStatement - disclosed as a needed follow-up rather than applied.

R1123.note: json_encode() into a bare JS literal is context-correct; PHP's default slash-escaping (\/) also neutralizes the </script> breakout even without explicit JSON_HEX_TAG flags.

R1124.note: NUL-terminates a fixed-size copy of the un-terminated line and adds the missing %255s width matching nameBuf's real size; sizes verified against the struct.

R1125.note: html/template auto-escapes Author/Excerpt; Content-Type and error-return contract preserved.

R1126.note: Strict allowlist regex on reportName plus ArgumentList closes the vector even given cmd.exe's re-parsing of .bat invocations; legitimate alphanumeric report names unaffected.

R1127.note: XmlResolver = null before LoadXml() is the standard, minimal XXE fix for XmlDocument; parsing of valid XML unaffected.

R1128.note: Static plugin-name-to-path registry with explicit rejection of unregistered names properly closes the traversal/arbitrary-require vector; unregistered plugins fail loudly (400) rather than silently.

R1129.note: c:out is the right mechanism, but ${displayName} is a JSTL EL expression while displayName is only a local scriptlet variable never placed in any scope, so EL can never resolve it - the welcome banner silently renders blank for every request, and the write-up also silently changes the unrelated Log out link from /logout to /account/logout.

R1130.note: Only blocks non-http(s) schemes; there is no host allowlist, so the reported vulnerability - redirect to an arbitrary untrusted external site like https://evil.com - remains fully exploitable. Requiring both scheme and host also silently breaks legitimate relative-path redirects that previously worked.

R1131.note: Rejects empty/./../separator-containing filenames as a single path component, matching the file's own 'no subdirectories' contract; legitimate single-name saves unaffected.

R1132.note: Laravel query builder binds region as a parameter; DB::raw() is only used for the fixed aggregate expression, not user input.

R1133.note: CBC with random IV prepended is correct; no downstream decrypt consumer in the case to break, format change disclosed.

R1134.note: mysqli prepared statement with bind_param preserves the function's signature and return shape exactly.

R1135.note: fgets() with sizeof bound plus draining/rejecting a line missing its newline correctly prevents both overflow and truncation-bypass; fits-in-buffer case still copies into out and returns 0 as before.

R1136.note: Allowlist prevents raw SQL text in Order(), but introduces a new sort-key vocabulary (id_asc, created_at_desc, ...) unrelated to the original raw fragment values a caller likely sent, silently defaulting any unrecognized value - including the old format - to id ASC; disclosed as intended fallback in the explanation.

R1137.note: Parameterized CallableStatement is the right shape for this sink, but collapses the original 'any procedure named by the header' behavior to one hardcoded placeholder procedure, changing the endpoint's actual behavior; write-up explicitly flags this as needing developer follow-up.

R1138.note: Checks the boolean return of verify() and rejects with 401 before using claims; minimal and correct.

R1139.note: html.escape() replaces the unsafe Markup() wrap; rendered banner structure and status text unchanged.

R1140.note: Named parameter binds searchTerm with wildcards included in the bound value; method signature and results unchanged.
